purpose: Forecast-only, common-footprint, same-calendar-month and same-lead distribution comparison between the 2023 training features and sealed 2026 JJAS forecast features
case_rule: Only 2023 JJAS rows in the existing 2023 training X and 2026 JJAS strict-QC forecast leads; exclude the eight October 2023 training cases from this comparison. Group independently by initialization month and Day 1/2/3 lead. Never select cases from observed rainfall or 2026 outcomes.
spatial_rule: Require the 2023 pixel_index to be the same 1301 unique 49x49 flattened indices for all training cases. Subset every 2026 2401-cell forecast X to exactly those ordered indices. Require latitude, longitude and lead columns to match the corresponding 2023 stratum exactly.
features: Report every forecast-time dynamic column in phase2b.FEATURE_NAMES; exclude only latitude_deg, longitude_deg and lead_hours from distribution summaries. Do not select features after seeing a result.
statistics: For each month, lead and dynamic feature, report 2023 and 2026 cell-value p01, median and p99; 2026 minus 2023 median; and the 2026 fraction outside the 2023 stratum p0.1-p99.9 range. Report forecast-case and cell counts. These are descriptive; no hypothesis test or gate is inferred.
interpretation_limits: The 2023 and 2026 dates are not meteorologically paired, and strict-QC admission differs by year.
Cell values are spatially dependent; quantiles are descriptions, not independent-sample uncertainty.
A distribution shift does not identify a GEFS executable or prove a cause, skill change, selected-predictor equivalence, or operational suitability.
No observation, rainfall target, reanalysis at valid time, 2026 score, model fit, threshold selection, or promotion is allowed.
